title: PROD | NMS | Unable to add SNMP Catalogue for Linux SNMP and Windows SNMP
description:
Currently, when a device is onboarded as *Linux (SNMP)* or {*}Windows (SNMP){*}, it is not possible to add or associate new Metric Groups from the {*}Device Catalogue{*}.

During validation, we observed that these device types are not available in the required device type mapping at the code level. As a result, the test environment is unable to identify Linux (SNMP) and Windows (SNMP) devices for test OID while creating or assigning Metric Groups.

*Current Behavior:*
 * Linux (SNMP) and Windows (SNMP) device types are missing from the required mapping.
 * Metric Groups cannot be created or associated with these device types.

*Expected Behavior:*
 * Linux (SNMP) and Windows (SNMP) should be available in the supported device type mapping so that Metric Groups can be created and assigned successfully through the Device Catalogue.
